headline: North Georgia alone have matches left to play
dek: North Georgia travel to West Alabama on Friday and to Catawba on Sunday, the only matches left on any programme's calendar. They go with thirteen wins, five draws and three defeats, and have not played since Saturday's defeat at Flagler.
displaced_by: Two North Georgia matches are now on the calendar, so the standing dek's claim that Saturday's match was the last one is no longer true.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Fourteen different players have scored North Georgia's 44 goals, so their attack is spread across the squad rather than leaning on one scorer.

wire.line: Flagler have won every match since Florida Southern beat them in September.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches have passed their date with no published result, every one of them from August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Middle Georgia State have conceded 54 goals, more than any other programme in the conference, while scoring 29.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Javier Gongora Andres has scored eleven of Middle Georgia State's 29 goals from 55 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Finn Weigelt has scored eleven of Flagler's 42 goals from 38 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Isaac Calderon has scored ten of North Georgia's 44 goals from 52 shots.

last_match.line: Lander are the only side besides Flagler to have beaten North Georgia this season.

next_match.line: West Alabama lost on both of their September visits to this conference, at Middle Georgia State and Georgia Southwestern.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
